title: Report unknown currency when the decision commit or head is unreadable
preconditions: An approved slide and its code are unchanged; prepare separate checkouts where either the decision commit is unavailable or the followed review head cannot resolve.

steps.action: Read the decision in the checkout missing its original commit.
steps.expected_result: Currency is unknown with a diagnostic naming the missing decision commit.

steps.action: In the independent missing-head checkout, read the decision.
steps.expected_result: Currency is unknown with a diagnostic explaining that the review head could not be read.

expected_result: Currency is unknown with a diagnostic explaining that the review head could not be read.
